title: Strict finite point transport laws on every complex
statement: Fix the finite field datum D, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. The natural index n denotes the positive exponent n+1. For every complex P of completed integral sheaves on $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, let $u_n(P)$ be strictQuotientPointMap of [lem-trf-point-transport-strict-quotient]. These maps commute strictly with the quotient-induced source and finite pullback transitions of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. They are natural in every complex morphism, and on a final-object section x their degree-i value is restriction by geometric Frobenius, followed by the finite pullback tensor-unit generator and restriction along the canonical comma arrow. These three assertions hold before localization, with no good-representative assumption.

source.place: clause *(3)*: the integral point transport is the derived limit of the levelwise maps, via its specified cone map

proof.text: Apply the already proved strictQuotientPointMap_identities: its first component gives the transition equality and its third component gives naturality for arbitrary complexes. Apply strictQuotientPointMap_sections for the stated section formula. Combine these three conclusions by conjunction introduction; no good-representative assumption is needed.

mathlib_searches.query: exact evaluation commutes with the mapping cone realization of a strict inverse tower of complexes
mathlib_searches.results: MappingCone functoriality and mapHomologicalComplex comparisons only; no specific quotient transport or completeness unit theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: exact point sections of the canonical completion unit of a derived complete complex is an isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Completion of normed modules and general Kan-extension units; no coefficient sheaf completion or specified point transport.
mappingCocone.lift and its two projection formulas supply the cone assembly, but neither of the coefficient-specific assertions.

Sheaf PointTransportStrictQuotient states its laws only on good complexes. PointSectionsCompletionCone uses integralScalarTowerFunctor rather than the actual unrestricted quotient tower. No existing ordinary-module theorem states these exact interfaces. Mathlib only has generic cone functoriality.

The existing PointTransportStrictQuotientIdentities and PointTransportStrictQuotientSections modules prove all three assertions, without a good-representative assumption. The reviewer supplied the direct conjunction proof.

lean.statement:
theorem pointTransport_strictQuotient_allComplexes (_hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
      ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).app P) ≫
          strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P =
        strictQuotientPointMap D l E (n + 1) P ≫
          ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            ((integralOperationsPullbackTransition l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).app P)) ∧
    (∀ (P P' : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ)
      (f : P ⟶ P') (n : ℕ),
      ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          ((unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).map f) ≫
          strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P' =
        strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P ≫
          ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            ((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).map f)) ∧
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ)
      (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
      (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i).val.obj
        (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))),
      ((strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P).f i) x =
        ((((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).obj P).X i).val.map
          (proEtaleIsoCommaArrow (frobeniusPointIso D).hom
            (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k))))).op
          (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n
            (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i)
            ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).obj
              (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))
            ((((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i).val.map
              (frobeniusPointRestriction D).op x))))
